{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill grants or amplifies its matching Primary Spirit Hall Bonus with {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|%+|]{/c} potency for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

Your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills each gain an additional Skill Type:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Seeker{/c} is a {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Hunter{/c} is a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is a {c_important}Potency{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Protector{/c} is a {c_important}Defensive{/c} Skill.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
